articles.title: Jeff Bezos is in Agreement with Sam Altman: We are in an Artificial Intelligence Bubble but the Benefits will be Enormous
articles.description: Jeff Bezos, like Sam Altman, acknowledges that there is a bubble in the field of artificial intelligence, but says its benefits to society will be "enormous". Altman had stated that bubbles usually emerge with people's excessive enthusiasm for the essence of a fact, and that they can still bring significant gains to the economy. Bezos, in his speech at Tech Week in Italy, emphasized that this process is an industrial bubble, not a financial one, just like the biotechnology bubble in the 1990s, and that it will ultimately bring significant benefits to society. Although many companies went bankrupt at that time, life-saving drugs were developed. Bezos stated that industrial bubbles are "not as bad as others" and that societies benefit from the winners, and expressed that artificial intelligence will also transform all sectors in the same way.

[Artificial Intelligence](https://www.nuvemmag.com/post-category/yapay-zeka)

6/10/2025

# Jeff Bezos Agrees with Sam Altman: We're in an AI Bubble, but the Benefits Will Be Enormous

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e381fca6aa11f03ce6effa_bezos-ai-bubble-gigantic-societal-benefits-1024x683.jpg)

Jeff Bezos has joined **Sam Altman** in acknowledging the existence of a bubble in the field of artificial intelligence, but the founder of Amazon believes this situation will bring **great benefits**.

Recently, many artificial intelligence companies have faced great optimism and rapid increases in valuations. In August, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that there was a bubble in the AI market. Altman said that when bubbles form, " **intelligent people become overly invested in the essence of a truth**," drawing a parallel to the dot-com burst of the 1990s. However, he expressed his personal view that " **it will generally bring a significant net gain to the economy**."

Now, Bezos is also talking about an AI bubble, but painting a more optimistic picture for the future.

The point that worries investors is the similarity between this bubble and the dot-com bubble of the late 1990s, which carries high financial risks. However, Bezos stated that the nature of the current AI bubble is different and should be a source of comfort for investors. Bezos said at the Tech Week event in Italy, " **This is a kind of industrial bubble, different from financial bubbles**."

Bezos also emphasized that industrial bubbles can ultimately produce positive results. Citing the biotechnology and pharmaceutical bubble of the 1990s as an example, he noted that many companies went bankrupt or were sold at a fraction of their value, but in the end, life-saving drugs were developed. **The Wall Street Journal** reported in 2004 that the cumulative losses of publicly traded biotechnology companies exceeded $40 billion.

Nevertheless, Bezos said that industrial bubbles are " **not as bad as other bubbles**." " **In fact, they can be good, because when the dust settles, the winners emerge, and societies benefit from investors. The same thing will happen here. The reality of AI is out there, and the benefits it will bring to society will be enormous**," he said.

Bezos also reminded that during bubble periods, everything gets funded. " **In such exciting times, investors struggle to distinguish between good and bad ideas**," he added, saying that the same situation is happening today with AI investments.

Meta CEO **Mark Zuckerberg** also made similar statements recently, saying that there might be a bubble in AI, but his company would rather " **spend a few hundred billion dollars incorrectly than miss the super-intelligent train**."

Bezos, however, emphasized that the discussion of a bubble should not overshadow the transformative potential of AI: " **The possibility of a bubble does not mean that the developments in AI are not real. AI is real, and it will change every industry**."

articles.title: OpenAI and AMD Partnership Worth Billions of Dollars: 6 Gigawatt Chip Deal and 10% Stake Possibility
articles.description: OpenAI and AMD announced a partnership that could exceed $60 billion, in which AMD processors will be used in artificial intelligence data centers. Within the scope of the agreement, OpenAI will purchase AMD chips starting with the MI450 model from next year, with a power of 6 gigawatts, and in return, will have the right to acquire up to 160 million shares, equivalent to approximately 10% of AMD, at a price of $0.01 per share. While AMD CEO Lisa Su stated that the agreement will provide the company with tens of billions of dollars in revenue over the next five years, it was announced that the first distribution will begin in the second half of 2026 with 1-gigawatt MI450 chips. On the other hand, the $100 billion, 10-gigawatt data center agreement with Nvidia has not been finalized yet, but the AMD partnership was described as "definite" and it was announced that it will be reported to regulators.

# OpenAI and AMD Announce Billion-Dollar Partnership: 6 Gigawatt Chip Deal and 10% Stake Possibility

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e4c896c5833b991ceb9dae_Us56KqCCWo8Phke9.jpg)

**OpenAI** and **AMD** have announced a multi-billion dollar partnership, where AMD processors will be used in OpenAI's artificial intelligence data centers. As part of the agreement, OpenAI has committed to purchasing **6 gigawatt AMD chips** starting with the MI450 model from next year. These purchases can be made directly through AMD or via cloud computing partners. **AMD CEO Lisa Su** stated in an interview with the Wall Street Journal that the deal is expected to generate tens of billions of dollars in revenue for AMD over the next five years.

The companies did not disclose the full financial details of the agreement, but AMD emphasized that each "gigawatt" capacity is worth tens of billions of dollars. Therefore, the total value of the deal is **estimated to be over $60 billion**.

In return, OpenAI will have the option to acquire **up to 160 million shares** of AMD, equivalent to approximately **10% of AMD's shares**. The share price will be **$0.01**, and this option will be granted gradually as OpenAI meets its distribution targets. The warrants can only be exercised if AMD's stock price rises, but the details are not yet clear.

This deal is seen as a massive gain for AMD, and it is being evaluated alongside the **Nvidia-Intel partnership** announced last month. In that deal, Nvidia and Intel are jointly developing Intel x86 RTX SOC processors containing Nvidia graphics units and custom data center-focused x86 processors. Nvidia also received **$5 billion in shares** from Intel.

OpenAI plans to use AMD's chips, particularly in **inference processes**, to meet growing demand. **Sam Altman** stated in a statement to the WSJ: _"It's impossible to exaggerate how difficult it's become... We want everything to be very fast, but it's taking a little time."_

**AMD Chairman and CEO Dr. Lisa Su** evaluated the partnership as _"We are thrilled to partner with OpenAI. We are combining our powers to deliver artificial intelligence computing on a massive scale. This collaboration will enable the world's most ambitious artificial intelligence structure while creating a true win-win situation for the entire artificial intelligence ecosystem."_

The first application will start with **1 gigawatt MI450 chips** in the second half of 2026. Altman explained the current state of artificial intelligence infrastructure: _"We are now at a point where the entire industry needs to come together, and everyone will get very good results. It's not just about chips and data centers, but also the rest of the supply chain."_

OpenAI has also signed a **$100 billion deal with Nvidia**, aiming to secure **10 gigawatt artificial intelligence data centers**. However, the Nvidia deal has not been finalized yet. On the other hand, the AMD-OpenAI partnership has been described as **"definitive"** by the companies, and the necessary details will be submitted to regulatory agencies immediately. The Nvidia deal has not yet reached the same stage.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Became the First Billionaire in Football History with His Record-Breaking Contract in Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo became the first billionaire player in football, increasing his wealth to $1.4 billion thanks to his contract with Saudi Arabia's Al-Nassr club, which exceeds $400 million. His life, which began in poverty in Madeira, was taken to the top with his career at Sporting, Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus, earning $550 million in salaries between 2002-2023, and $175 million from Nike and other sponsorships. Ronaldo, who expanded his wealth with the CR7 brand, hotels, real estate, and investments in Lisbon, became the world's most popular Instagram user with over 660 million followers. While Messi earns $20 million annually, Ronaldo's income in Saudi Arabia reached nearly ten times that amount; his contract included privileges such as a signing bonus, private jet, and club shares. As one of the oldest active players in professional football, the player plans to retire and become a club owner at Al-Nassr; with the extension of his contract, he took the first step towards this goal by acquiring a 15% stake in Al-Nassr.

# Cristiano Ronaldo Became the First Billionaire in Football History with His Record-Breaking Contract in Saudi Arabia

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e7734b1a6b6c9df88b8771_ac-08_10-ronaldo-billionaire-op.png)

Cristiano Ronaldo's football career has been filled with numerous firsts, from his record transfer to Real Madrid to becoming the all-time top scorer. Now, he has achieved a new record off the field: **he has become the first billionaire football player**. After more than 20 years with top European clubs like Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus, the 40-year-old Portuguese star has earned significant income from his contracts with brands like Armani and Nike. However, his major breakthrough came with his contract with **Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia**, valued at over **$400 million**, signed in June. According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, Ronaldo's wealth has risen to **$1.4 billion**, making him the first football player to reach this level. For years, Ronaldo had similar salaries to Lionel Messi, but he surpassed his rival with his transfer to the Gulf in 2023. Messi is expected to become a shareholder in Inter Miami when he ends his career.

Ronaldo had stated that he was looking for a new challenge, saying that he had "won everything in Europe." His transfer to Riyadh-based Al-Nassr resulted in one of the biggest contracts in football history. The contract includes an average annual salary of over $200 million, tax-free, as well as additional bonuses, a $30 million signing bonus, private jet usage, and a share in the club. This contract not only made him the highest-paid football player but also one of the highest-paid athletes overall.

Lionel Messi has a guaranteed annual salary of $20 million since 2023 and a revenue-sharing agreement with Apple, but Ronaldo's earnings in Saudi Arabia are approximately ten times Messi's guaranteed income over two seasons. David Beckham earned around $100 million throughout his football career. These figures demonstrate how quickly footballers' earnings have risen in recent years.

### **A Difficult Start**

Ronaldo, who grew up in poverty on the island of Madeira, dropped out of school at 14 to focus on football. The young talent's star rose with Sporting Lisbon, and he was soon transferred to Manchester United and then to Real Madrid in 2009. His contracts were among the highest at the time. Over the years, he earned **$550 million** from his salaries between 2002 and 2023. He signed a 10-year contract with **Nike** worth around **$18 million** per year and made advertising deals with **Armani** and **Castrol**, adding $175 million to his wealth. Aurélio Pereira, who discovered Ronaldo at Sporting, remembers him as a "_shy, slender but extraordinarily talented child, nicknamed UFO_". Today, Madeira has an airport, museum, and hotel chain named after him.

Ronaldo's wealth is managed by **LMcapital Wealth Management**, based in Lisbon. The company's head, Miguel Marques, previously worked at a Swiss bank and now operates on one of Lisbon's most prestigious streets. The firm has been managing €1.4 billion in assets since 2018. Ronaldo focuses his investments on his home country and makes decisions with his close circle of friends. In 2024, he bought the Lisbon Racket Center and considered becoming a partner in the City of Padel club. Although his CR7 brand, hotel chain, gyms, and media group are significant investments, his football contracts remain his primary source of wealth.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e772e765e5adcce11db599_ca5eb00e646d111bd4710ce08bc63520fdd62470.webp)

Ronaldo's extensive real estate portfolio includes a mansion in Madeira, a penthouse in Lisbon purchased at a record price, and a mansion in Quinta da Marinha worth around €20 million.

### **What's Next?**

Ronaldo, with **over 660 million followers**, is the most popular Instagram user in the world. His arrival in Saudi Arabia made a significant impact, with tens of thousands of people attending his first match. Although interest in the matches has decreased over time, Ronaldo has defended the Saudi Pro League, claiming it is more competitive than France's Ligue 1. He has praised the country's security and beauty, often sharing his experiences on the Red Sea coast. As one of the oldest active professional footballers, he plans to retire at Al-Nassr. Ronaldo has stated that his dream is to own several football clubs, and with the extension of his contract, he has taken his first step by acquiring a 15% stake in Al-Nassr.

articles.title: The First Country in the World Where Doctors Can Prescribe Nature for Health
articles.description: Sweden is introducing itself as "the first country in the world where doctors can prescribe health" with the "The Swedish Prescription" campaign, and activities that can be added to the prescription include improving sleep quality by saunaing in Lapland, strengthening circulation with cold water diving in the archipelagos, reducing stress by listening to bird songs, increasing serotonin levels by visiting museums, and strengthening social bonds with traditional fika breaks. Susanne Andersson, CEO of Visit Sweden, the country's official tourism promotion agency, describes the campaign, saying "The Swedish lifestyle naturally promotes health; free access to our impressive forests and lakes, clean air, cool summers, healthy fika breaks, and vibrant cultural life are the best examples of this." Surveys show that people are open to nature, social, and cultural prescriptions, while the WHO (World Health Organization) emphasizes that nature and cultural prescriptions are becoming an increasingly important strategy for human health.

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd963/67bf9412114f3b42d018b19a_NuvemMag-Logo.png)](https://www.nuvemmag.com/)


[Agenda](https://www.nuvemmag.com/post-category/gundem)

10/10/2025

# The First Country in the World Where Doctors Can Prescribe Health

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8de870c5491a0ce826c8e_iStock-2174196369.avif)

Sweden claims to be the "first country in the world where doctors can prescribe health" to attract tourists. The campaign, called **"The Swedish Prescription"**, highlights the country's natural environment and lifestyle appeal. As part of the campaign, visitors are offered experiences such as a sauna experience in Lapland to improve sleep quality or diving into cold water in the archipelago to strengthen blood circulation.

**Susanne Andersson**, CEO of **Visit Sweden**, the country's official tourism promotion agency, said: "_The Swedish lifestyle naturally promotes health; free access to our impressive forests and lakes, clean air, cool summers, healthy fika breaks, and vibrant cultural life are all great examples of this._"

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8de92369501ec18a05a52_1758601375-edm-VisitSwedenPrescription2.webp)

"Fika" is a concept that refers to having a conversation over coffee and sweets, which is more than just a regular coffee break but less formal than an official meeting, and is an important part of Swedish culture. The podcast **A Swedish Fika** describes fika as "_a way to recharge your batteries, relax a bit, and gather your thoughts before continuing your day_". Swedish food brand **Himmelsö** explains fika as "_a warm, kind, and pleasant way to bring people together_".

In addition to the fun side of the campaign, there is also a serious aspect. A **YouGov** survey conducted earlier this year found that most participants had never heard of nature, social, or cultural prescriptions, but two-thirds of respondents said they would be open to implementing such a prescription.

**Stacy Beller Stryer**, deputy medical director of the non-profit organization **Park RX America**, emphasized the therapeutic effects of nature, social environments, and culture. "_It is clear that Sweden has an abundance of these resources. I would be happy to discuss with my patients how Sweden's nature and lifestyle can benefit their health, and I am open to prescribing a visit to Sweden if my patients wish_".

The **World Health Organization (WHO)** also states that nature plays a critical role in human health and well-being. In recent years, nature prescriptions have become more prominent as a preventive health strategy, with studies showing benefits for physical and mental health. Similar effects have been observed for social and cultural prescriptions.

Beller Stryer continued: "_We have made significant progress in making nature prescriptions a more integrated part of public health, but there is still much to be done._" She welcomed Sweden's initiative, saying: "_I hope it will help remove institutional and organizational barriers and ultimately benefit all patients._"

**The Swedish Prescription** includes a list of scientifically validated activities that can be used as a basis for discussions between patients and doctors and can facilitate doctors' prescription-writing activities. The activities include fika, as well as listening to bird sounds to reduce stress and visiting museums to increase serotonin levels.

articles.title: The Airbus A320 has surpassed the Boeing 737 as the most delivered passenger aircraft in the world.
articles.description: Europe-based Airbus has surpassed Boeing 737 with the A320 family, reaching 12,260 deliveries since 1988, and became the best-selling commercial airliner in history. This record, broken with the delivery of an A320neo to Saudi airline Flynas, was shaped by increasing demand and the proliferation of low-cost airlines due to economically driven growth led by Asia. The A320 project, launched in 1984, introduced a major innovation by bringing fly-by-wire technology to civil aviation; despite being challenged by political disagreements between France and Germany, Thatcher's Concorde warnings, and state aid debates, it was regarded as the "first successful commercial jet outside the US". Today, while Airbus plans to increase production capacity in the US and China, Boeing is recovering from the crisis caused by the 737 MAX crashes. Although Airbus and Boeing have delivered over 25,000 aircraft together, new competitors such as Embraer and JetZero are emerging; industry officials emphasize that new models will only be considered when progress is made in areas like engine technology.

[Science and World](https://www.nuvemmag.com/post-category/bilim-dunya)

10/10/2025

# Airbus A320 Becomes the Best-Selling Passenger Aircraft in the World, Surpassing Boeing 737

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8e140d2fcb236405a5118_a321neo-inflight_source_airbus_revised.webp)

European-based Airbus crossed an important commercial threshold on Tuesday, surpassing Boeing 737 with its A320 family and becoming the best-selling passenger aircraft in history. Boeing's decades-long record ended with the delivery of an A320neo to Saudi airline **Flynas**. According to data from **Cirium**, a UK-based aviation analytics firm, the total number of A320 series deliveries, which entered service in 1988, has reached 12,260.

Airbus and Boeing did not comment on these figures, which are tracked by **Cirium's leading aircraft supply analyst Rob Morris**. In recent years, economic growth led by Asia has increased demand for both the A320 and 737, carrying millions of new middle-class passengers to the skies. To date, Airbus and Boeing have delivered over 25,000 aircraft together. Initially designed to serve major hubs, these aircraft have also been widely adopted by low-cost airlines over time. After the 9/11 attacks, when Boeing reduced production due to decreased demand, Airbus targeted this market.

Already the world's largest aircraft manufacturer in terms of annual deliveries, Airbus has now also taken the top spot in terms of total narrow-body aircraft deliveries. This marks a milestone in the 40-year transatlantic market battle, which began with discussions on work-sharing and strategy between France, Germany, Spain, and the UK. **Adam Pilarski, former chief economist at Douglas Aircraft**, said, _"Initially, no one thought it would be successful, now it's at least winning in the larger variants."_

### **Decades-Long Transatlantic Competition**

Launched in 1984, the A320 program emerged during a period when Airbus's future was uncertain. Developed after the troubled start of two wide-body aircraft, the A320 made its first flight in 1987 and entered service the following year. Engineers in Toulouse took a bold step by integrating computer-controlled fly-by-wire systems into a mainstream passenger aircraft. Despite resistance from unions and some airlines, this technology eventually became a sector standard.

The A320, developed under the leadership of **Roger Beteille**, one of Airbus's founders, was the subject of significant debates over whether to focus on the 150-seat market demanded by US airlines (with French support) or prioritize wide-body aircraft (with Lufthansa's support). The project was saved from collapse when French President **François Mitterrand** and German Chancellor **Helmut Kohl** chose the same person, Bavarian politician **Franz-Josef Strauss**, as a mediator. Strauss's role in resolving the dispute by exchanging letters between the two leaders is told in the official Airbus history book **Airbus: The First 50 Years**, although the book was later withdrawn; Reuters obtained a copy.

Another factor that put the project in jeopardy was doubts about investments from European governments. UK Prime Minister **Margaret Thatcher** said in parliament in 1984, _"I don't want another Concorde,"_ referring to the cost overruns of the Anglo-French Concorde. Boeing had long criticized European state support.

### **Europe's First Commercial Jet Success**

The A320, which features high technology but is visually unremarkable, grew rapidly, leaving behind the short-lived Concorde production line and eventually expanding into the space left by the discontinued A380. In the coming weeks, Airbus plans to expand its production capacity in the US and China. **Max Kingsley-Jones, head of Cirium's consulting division**, said, _"It was the first truly successful commercial jet outside the US. It forced competitors to create competitive alternatives."_

After Airbus received a surprise order from **United Airlines** in 1992, Boeing responded with the 737NG version. However, despite strong sales, the third-generation 737 MAX was plagued by two fatal crashes in 2018 and 2019, pushing Boeing into crisis. The company is trying to stabilize under the management of new CEO **Kelly Ortberg**. The A320 also experienced two accidents in its early years, sparking debates about the balance between pilot control and automation.

Today, the Western duopoly is facing threats from China and other manufacturers. Brazilian **Embraer** is debating whether to enter the larger market beyond regional jets, while California-based startup **JetZero** is proposing a new concept that radically deviates from traditional body design. Industry sources say that Airbus and Boeing are not willing to replace their profitable existing models anytime soon. Boeing is struggling with debt, while Airbus is leading with its price advantage and strong sales.

Executives from both companies said at the **International Society of Transport Aircraft Trading (ISTAT)** conference in Prague that developing a new model would have to wait until progress is made in areas like engine technology. Rob Morris said, _"Boeing cannot catch up with the A320 family with its current production plans, but this situation may strengthen its determination to think about what comes after the 737 when the right conditions arise."_

articles.title: The James Webb Telescope May Have Seen "Dark Stars" in the Distant Corners of the Universe
articles.description: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has identified four potential "dark star" candidates that could date back 500 million years after the Big Bang; among them, JADES-GS-z14-0 is the second most distant object ever observed, showing a "smoking gun" sign with the helium absorption line at 1640 angstroms. According to a hypothesis proposed in 2007, dark stars are formed by the combination of hydrogen and helium with dark matter, and can be a million times heavier and a billion times brighter than the Sun. Study co-author Katherine Freese said, "Our initial name 'dark star' is misleading; they are not made entirely of dark matter and are not dark," suggesting that the findings could explain mysterious objects in the early universe. Researchers examined NIRSpec data and nominated JADES-GS-z11-0, z13-0, z14-0, and z14-1 as candidates; however, the ALMA telescope detected oxygen, which is only formed in fusion stars, in JADES-GS-z14-0, prompting Freese to say, "This worries me a bit." Cosmologist Daniel Whalen from the University of Portsmouth, who was not involved in the study, noted that dark stars are not distinguished from supermassive primordial stars, while co-author Cosmin Ilie emphasized that much more observation is needed. The team now plans to automate their search.

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd963/67bf9412114f3b42d018b19a_NuvemMag-Logo.png)](https://www.nuvemmag.com/)


[Science and World](https://www.nuvemmag.com/post-category/bilim-dunya)

10/10/2025

# The James Webb Telescope May Have Seen "Dark Stars" in the Distant Corners of the Universe

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8f3d1ff201f1ff26d71d2_stsci-01gq5chesabwmhrf5na60a6mpf_0.png)

The second most distant object observed by the **James Webb Telescope** may be a "dark star" powered by dark matter instead of nuclear fusion. Researchers analyzing the light wave lengths collected by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) identified four objects, including four dark star candidates. One of them has a helium absorption signature that can be considered "definitive evidence". The study was published in the **PNAS** journal on September 30.

According to the theory first proposed in 2007, dark stars could be some of the first stars (Population III stars) formed after the Big Bang. The theory suggests that a mixture of hydrogen and helium, which would normally form a black hole, could create a dark star when combined with dark matter. It is thought that these stars could reach a mass of one million times that of the Sun and a brightness of one billion times that of the Sun. **Professor Katherine Freese from the University of Texas**, who first proposed the hypothesis, said, _"Our initial name 'dark star' is misleading; they are not made entirely of dark matter and are not dark either."_ Freese stated that the discovery of dark stars could explain the unexplained objects observed by JWST in the early universe, such as rapidly forming giant black holes, and said, _"This is not just a new type of star, but also a tool. The candidates are very encouraging for us."_

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8f2f3fa22351df0093a3e_wnmeHkvAwMTSavjfKJxMjf-970-80.jpg.webp)

The research team scanned the JWST's Advanced Deep Extragalactic Research (JADES) observations, particularly the data collected with **NIRSpec** (Near-Infrared Spectrograph). The criteria included a redshift value of at least 10 (500 million years after the Big Bang), containing only hydrogen and helium, and coming from a single object.

As a result of the examination, four candidates were identified: **JADES-GS-z11-0, JADES-GS-z13-0, JADES-GS-z14-0, and JADES-GS-z14-1**. JADES-GS-z14-0 is the second most distant object observed by JWST to date. Models show that all of them could be dark stars, and may even indicate supermassive dark stars. In particular, JADES-GS-z14-0 has a "definitive signature" of single-ionized helium atoms absorbing light at a wavelength of 1640 angstroms. Researchers stated in their article, _"No other high-redshift object is expected to show such an absorption feature."_ and emphasized the possibility of JADES-GS-z14-0 being a dark star.

The team also noted that the **ALMA** telescope in Chile detected oxygen in JADES-GS-z14-0. Since oxygen can only be formed in stars that operate through nuclear fusion, this discovery raises some doubts. Freese said, _"This worries me a bit."_ Research co-author **Cosmin Ilie** stated that they ran simulations to understand how much oxygen could be tolerated before dark star formation is prevented, and said, _"Logic tells me there should be a transition."_ 

The existence of dark stars is still a topic of debate. **Daniel Whalen, a cosmologist from the University of Portsmouth**, who is not involved in the study, said, _"Most of the Population III star population does not think that stars burning with dark matter can form."_ Whalen also stated, _"The main problem here is that the study did not distinguish between dark stars and supermassive primordial stars. That's the real issue."_ According to him, while the candidates are larger than supermassive primordial stars, the wavelength data should be compared for both types of stars.

In response to the objections, Ilie stated that supermassive primordial stars have shorter lifetimes than dark stars, and if many suitable signatures are found, the statistical probability of being a dark star will be higher. He added that much more observation is needed to obtain more definitive results.

Freese said that the team is working to automate the search for dark stars in JWST data and stated, _"Now all we have to do is keep our eyes open."_

articles.title: Toyota's Experimental City Woven City Opens Its Doors
articles.description: Toyota and Woven by Toyota have officially opened Woven City, which was introduced at CES 2020 and built on a former factory site near Japan's Mount Fuji, in Shizuoka. The city, designed by Bjarke Ingels and established on a 175-acre site, operates entirely sustainably with hydrogen fuel cells and solar panels; its roads are reserved for autonomous vehicles, personal mobility solutions, and pedestrians. The city features two main participant profiles: Inventors, namely entrepreneurs, researchers, and companies, and Weavers, namely residents and visitors. Inventors aim to create new values by combining Toyota's production experience with WbyT's software power, based on the concept of "Multiplying Effect" (synergy born from the combination of different ideas), expressed in Japanese as Kakezan. Woven City, which will initially be home to approximately 300 people and will accommodate 2,000 people when completed, will be supported by robots and artificial intelligence systems in daily life.

# Toyota's Experimental City Woven City Opens Its Doors

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e4eb88197a912e92ffc312_maxresdefault.jpg)

Toyota Motor Corporation ("Toyota") and Woven by Toyota, Inc. ("WbyT") have officially opened **Toyota Woven City ("Woven City")**, which was first introduced at CES 2020 and developed jointly by the two companies. An event was held in Susono City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, with the participation of key stakeholders to mark the opening. As the first residents begin to move in, partner companies are also embarking on joint projects. Thus, Woven City has become a real-world test bed for mobility and a key milestone in Toyota's transformation into a mobility company.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e4f78559452248539a0d2d_toyota-woven-city-main-art.webp)

Woven City was built on a **175-acre site** in Japan, near Mount Fuji, where a former Toyota factory was located. The project was designed by Danish architect **Bjarke Ingels**, who is also the architect of many iconic buildings built for Google and the **2 World Trade Center** in New York.

The city is designed as a **living laboratory for the technologies of the future**. Autonomous vehicles, robotics, smart homes, personal mobility solutions, hydrogen-powered energy systems, and sensor-based AI solutions will be tested here. **James Kuffner, CEO of Toyota Research Institute Advanced Technology**, emphasized in his opening speech that Woven City will be a platform for exploring new technological possibilities, saying, "_Today's cities were shaped by cars._"

There are two participant profiles in the city. The first is called **Inventor**, which includes businesses, innovative companies, entrepreneurs, research institutions, and other innovative actors. By combining Toyota's production experience, WbyT's advanced software capabilities, and the unique contributions of Inventors, the goal is to create a "_**Kakezan**_" effect, a Japanese concept that refers to the "_multiplier effect_". This approach focuses on the emergence of new innovations and social values through the combination of different ideas and skills. Among the Inventors is singer-songwriter **Naoto Inti Raymi**, who prepared the city's march and sound logo as Woven City's first artist, bringing the number of Inventors to 20.

The second group, **Weavers**, consists of residents and visitors living in the city. Weavers contribute to the shaping of innovations by experiencing products and services and providing feedback. As of September 2025, Toyota Group employees and their families have started living in the city, with approximately **300 people** expected to reside there in the first phase. The acceptance of general visitors will begin in the fiscal year 2026.

**Infrastructure and lifestyle design** are one of the most striking aspects of Woven City. The city will be completely sustainable, with energy provided by Toyota's **hydrogen fuel cell technology** and photovoltaic panels installed on roofs. Buildings are largely made of wood, constructed using Japanese carpentry techniques. Green areas, native plants, and hydroponic systems are integrated into the city's fabric. Major infrastructure elements, hydrogen storage, water supply, and other systems are located underground. On the surface, home robots and sensor-based AI make daily life easier. According to the plan, waste will be collected automatically, and refrigerators will be filled with food on their own.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e4f7b4223f3182afecd607_toyota-woven-city-01.webp)

The **transportation infrastructure** has also been completely reconfigured. Vehicles used by people will not be allowed. The city's roads are divided into three sections: a lane for fast-moving autonomous transportation vehicles, a second lane for slow personal vehicles with pedestrians, and a third lane for pedestrian-only park-like walkways. The combination of different infrastructure elements "woven" together gave the project its name, also referencing Toyota's history of producing looms.

The acceleration program, announced on September 8, 2025, began with the "**Woven City Challenge: Hack the Mobility**" competition. The program offers entrepreneurs, universities, and research institutions the opportunity to submit their ideas for Kakezan collaboration. Applications will be accepted until October 14, 2025.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e4f7bda13baea4ec672abd_toyota-woven-city-04.webp)

To celebrate the official opening, Toyota and WbyT held the "**Woven City Official Launch: Weaving the Future―Day 01**" event. At the event, Inventors, Weavers, and partners came together for the first time. Company leaders thanked everyone who supported the Woven City vision and contributed to shaping the future of mobility. Naoto Inti Raymi also performed the march he prepared for Woven City at the event.

Toyota announced its goal of transforming into a mobility company at CES 2018 and introduced the Woven City concept at CES 2020. Today, the company is realizing this goal with a community of collaborators who share a similar vision. The products and services that will emerge from the Kakezan work in Woven City are expected to transform lives not only in the city but also in Japan and around the world.

When completed, Woven City is expected to be home to approximately **2,000 people**, and companies will also be allowed to operate there. While no clear information is provided about the costs, a company representative implied that the cost of living will be made affordable, saying it will be "_**Toyota pricing**_".

articles.title: The World's First Solar Furnace Recycles Steel Waste
articles.description: Switzerland-based Panatere has launched the world's first two solar furnaces in La Chaux-de-Fonds, starting to recycle steel waste from the luxury watch and medical industries. The systems, which concentrate sunlight up to 1,450 °C, consist of large and small-scale heliostats and hundreds of mirrors; metal scrap is melted and converted into new ingots. The new design has been confirmed to reach 2,000 °C with a concentration of 5,500 times. The company plans to open a full-scale factory by 2028 and aims to produce 1,000 tons of recycled steel per year using only solar energy. While traditional methods emit 6.8 kg of CO₂ per 1 kg of steel, the new technology reduces this amount to 41 grams, thus reducing the carbon footprint by 165 times.

# The World's First Solar Furnace Recycles Steel Waste

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e62be0f6a9658f48e0d274_A1_dd621c.jpeg)

A Switzerland-based company has launched the world's first two solar furnaces that use green energy to melt and recycle critical steel waste in the industry. **Panatere**, a pioneer in the transformation of recycled and recyclable raw materials in the Jura region, officially launched these groundbreaking facilities on October 3 in La Chaux-de-Fonds, the historic center of the watch industry.

The pilot systems were designed to recycle high-quality steel waste from watch manufacturers and medical device manufacturers in the region. Both industries are known for their intensive use of stainless steel and high-precision engineering standards. The project was carried out with the support of Haute Ecole Arc Ingénierie and Franche-Comté University within the framework of the **Interreg France–Switzerland program**. Panatere CEO **Raphael Broye** expressed his emotions at the ceremony, saying: _“I've been dreaming of this moment for 10 years.”_

### **Melting Metal with Sunbeams**

The innovative technology developed melts stainless steel without using fossil fuels by concentrating sunlight up to 1,450 degrees Celsius. The company's large-scale prototype uses a heliostat consisting of 40 movable mirrors covering an area of 138 square meters. The mirrors track the sun and reflect the light onto a 10-meter diameter concave concentrator.

The more compact system features a 30-square-meter heliostat and a smaller concentrator with approximately 460 mirrors covering an area of 12 square meters. In both furnaces, the light is directed into the pot in the solar reactor, melting the metal waste, and then casting it into new ingots. Both systems are based on a two-stage process that captures sunlight and increases its intensity thousands of times.

Loïc Bonsack, innovation and industrialization project manager at Panatere, commented on the new design: _“This second design, which we plan to prioritize in the future, can concentrate light up to 5,500 times the sun's intensity and produce temperatures of up to 2,000 degrees Celsius in the pot.”_

The data obtained was validated by simulations conducted by researchers from Franche-Comté University and Haute École Arc Ingénierie. The studies were carried out in collaboration with Panatere within the framework of the Interreg France–Switzerland Rasol program.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e62c10ed4fdb021e955020_indir.webp)

### **A Cleaner Future**

Panatere will continue to test and develop the technology in the coming years by collaborating with local companies. The company aims to open a full-scale factory in the region or in the Wallis mountains in southwestern Switzerland by 2028. When the facility becomes operational, it plans to produce **up to 1,000 tons of recycled steel per year** using only solar energy. Authorities believe that this innovation could significantly reduce carbon emissions and promote a circular economy in the high-tech manufacturing sector.

Material characterization expert **Raymond Constantin** emphasized: _“Our mission is also to analyze the recycled steel alloys to ensure the preservation of their quality.”_ The production of 1 kilogram of recycled steel using traditional methods results in approximately 6.8 kilograms of carbon dioxide emissions. With Panatere's new technology, this amount is expected to drop to 41 grams. This represents a reduction of more than **165 times** in the carbon footprint compared to traditional methods.

CEO Raphael Broye also highlighted the economic dimension: _“Today, there is truly an economic model to be developed. Considering price levels and metal scarcity, we are in a position to make these projects profitable, even with Swiss wages.”_

articles.title: Laundry Folding, Dish Placing Home Robot Figure 03 Introduced
articles.description: Figure AI drew attention with its human-like home robot, Figure 03, and was featured in Time magazine as one of the "Best Inventions of 2025". The fully electric robot, designed to be 9% lighter than its predecessor, stands out with its soft fabric-covered body, tactile sensor-equipped hands, palm cameras, and five-hour battery life. In the video released to the public, the robot is seen performing tasks such as cleaning, folding laundry, collecting dishes, and placing them in the dishwasher, with movements designed to be slow for safety reasons, although it can work much faster in a factory environment. The company is accelerating the development of the robot with its "visual-language-action artificial intelligence" using OpenAI models and Nvidia software, but no timeline or price has been announced for home use; it is initially expected to be used in factories.

# Figure 03, the Home Robot that Folds Laundry and Loads the Dishwasher, Introduced

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8b6f2b47d5b4a0f025baa_figure-03-time-best-inventions-2025-02_16a601.webp)

As I watched Figure 03 cleaning, folding laundry, loading the dishwasher, serving, and playing with the dog, I felt a sense of strangeness due to the combination of human-like movements and fundamental differences. This combination is what makes this moment transformative. We are on the cusp of an era of humanoid home robots, and Figure AI is moving forward on a path that is a bit unsettling but pioneering.

Figure AI introduced its latest robot update on Thursday (October 9) with a long video and was featured as one of **Time Magazine's Best Inventions of 2025**. Figure 03 was on the cover of Time, but in my opinion, this overestimates the robot's potential for home use. Time also stated: _“Figure 03 will not be ready for home use when it is released.”_

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8b6ffca9ff756b562f9ec_TIM251027_COVER-ROBOT_FINAL4.webp)

However, it is undeniable that Figure AI has made significant progress with its 1.68-meter-tall, fully electric automaton. Figure 03, which was introduced just a year after Figure 02, is quite different in terms of appearance and functionality. Most of the innovations were designed for safer and more functional use in a home environment. The design has softer lines and looks more natural in a home setting; almost the entire body is covered with a soft, woven fabric.

The fully articulated hands are also covered with fabric and feature wide-angle cameras on each palm to better perceive targets. There is also a camera on the head. The fingertips have been made softer, and each finger features the company's new tactile sensors. All these features, as seen in the video, enable Figure 03 to carefully collect plates from a table and sweep crumbs with its other hand.

The new hand design and cameras also allow Figure 03 to fold a shirt and slowly wash and load dishes into the dishwasher. Although its body resembles a human, it works in a semi-crouched position for some tasks; this posture could cause serious back problems for humans, but the algorithms may indicate that this movement pattern is the most suitable for the robot.

Figure 03 is 9% lighter to make it easier to move around the home. In the video, the robot is seen rising from a wireless charging station and moving around a large, open-plan house with a five-hour battery life. More foam has been added to its joints to prevent human fingers from getting pinched.

The robot's movements within the home appear quite cautious in the video. It moves at a speed of 2.6 miles per hour, which is a bit slow and sluggish. It was probably designed for safety, and it is notable that the robot works much faster in the factory section.

### **Artificial Intelligence Backbone**

Although Figure AI did not directly show it in the video, **generative artificial intelligence** plays a significant role in Figure 03's rapid development. The company stated that the robot works with a **"visual-language-action artificial intelligence"**. The robot uses OpenAI models and Nvidia's robotic software stack to understand spoken commands and perceive its surroundings. Without advancements in generative AI, it is unlikely that Figure 03 would have approached the level of a home robot so quickly.

However, there are many question marks about Figure 03. Figure AI has not announced a calendar for home delivery. In fact, it is expected that the robot will first be used in factories. Pricing is also uncertain, but it is expected to be in the tens of thousands of dollars.

The company faces strong competitors such as Tesla Optimus, Unitree G1, and Boston Dynamics Atlas. However, none of them have entered the home environment.

Figure AI stated last year when introducing Figure 01: _“We are facing very high risk and extremely low chance of success.”_ These words may be true for the entire humanoid robot industry in the short term.

In the long term, however, the prediction that home robot assistants will become normalized is gaining strength. It is likely that future generations will see robots like Figure 03 as ordinary, even if they seem a bit unsettling to humans now.

articles.title: Harvard Economist: Without Data Centers, US Growth Would Have Been 0.1% in the First Half of 2025
articles.description: Harvard economist Jason Furman stated that the growth of the US economy in the first half of 2025 in terms of GDP (Gross Domestic Product) was almost entirely due to investments in data centers and information processing technologies. While the official growth rate was around 1.3 percent, excluding these investments, growth would be only 0.1 percent. Furman said that even without these investments, lower interest rates and electricity prices could provide partial growth in other sectors, but this could offset at most half of the contribution of data centers. Renaissance Macro Research announced that data center spending by cloud providers (hyperscalers) exceeded consumer spending for the first time, while Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, and Nvidia invested tens of billions of dollars. Lisa Shalett from Morgan Stanley emphasized that hyperscaler spending has quadrupled in recent years, approaching $400 billion annually, and adding 100 basis points to GDP. Amazon founder Jeff Bezos described the explosion in data centers not as a financial bubble, but as an industrial one, but argued that this massive computing power will be a great gain for humanity in the long run.

# Harvard Economist: US Growth in the First Half of 2025 Would Have Been 0.1% Without Data Centers

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8d7033d1f4d01746c66d7_Z7dk757c43Q3gB6D_AIDataCenter.avif)

The growth of the US economy in the first half of 2025 was almost entirely driven by investments in data centers and computing technology. **Jason Furman**, an economist at Harvard University, calculated in a post on X.com on September 27 that if these technology-related categories were excluded, the annualized GDP growth would have been only 0.1%. The rate presents a stagnant picture, highlighting the critical role of high-tech infrastructure in shaping macroeconomic outcomes.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8d7cefc7953b562444fbd_f40fa51fb1ad115fb31d73c56737bae8e1b2394d-4065x2710.webp)

**Jason Furman**

Furman's findings were supported by many financial analysts, including **Robert Armstrong**, a columnist for the Financial Times' _Unhedged_, after they were shared online. In August, **Renaissance Macro Research** had predicted that YZ data center investments would contribute more to GDP growth in 2025 than US consumer spending for the first time. This result is quite striking, given that consumer spending accounts for two-thirds of GDP.

Technically, according to Furman's calculations, investments in computing equipment and software accounted for only 4% of the US GDP in the first half of 2025, but these items accounted for **92%** of the GDP growth recorded during the same period. Furman stated that if there were no YZ investments, the US economy would not have grown, but some growth could have occurred under different conditions: _"If there were no YZ boom, we would probably have lower interest rates and electricity prices, so we would see a bit more growth in other sectors. With a very rough calculation, we could offset about half of the growth from YZ, but still, this is a huge effect."_

Technology giants such as Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, and Nvidia have invested tens of billions of dollars in data centers to meet the massive demand for YZ and large language models. **Lisa Shallet**, Chief Investment Officer at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, said in an assessment on September 29, _"In recent years, the capital expenditures of hyperscalers in data centers and related areas have quadrupled and are approaching $400 billion annually."_ According to Shallet, the speed of growth and the size of the investment are distorting the overall economic impact. The top 10 investors account for approximately one-third of all expenditures, and it is estimated that only data center-related expenditures add about 100 basis points to the US's real GDP growth.

### **The "Mystery" in the Economy**

This technology-driven growth is accompanied by a general economic slowdown and, paradoxically, strong GDP figures. Employment growth has slowed; there are concerns that the US economy may have entered a recession if technology investments are excluded. Many sectors, such as manufacturing, real estate, retail, and services, made very little contribution to growth in the first half or reduced total output.

Despite this, **Torsten Sløk**, Chief Economist at Apollo Global Management, stated that GDP figures indicate a strong economy statistically. Sløk said in a note to clients at the beginning of October, _"Since January, the consensus among economists has been that the US economy would slow down for nine months. But the truth is, it didn't happen... We economists should look in the mirror."_ 

Furman's analysis reinforces the ironic observation of **Rusty Foster**, the author of _Today in Tabs_: _"Our economy may just be three YZ data centers inside a trench coat"_. This phrase refers to both the boom in data center construction and the cartoon joke where children stand on top of each other inside a trench coat to mimic an adult.

**Michael Gapen**, Chief Economist at Morgan Stanley, tried to explain the "mystery" of the 2025 economy on October 6. _"The difference between strong spending data and weak employment can be explained by companies absorbing the initial cost of tariffs, reducing unit labor costs and profitability. They chose this path instead of raising prices."_ 

Amazon founder **Jeff Bezos** believes that the boom in data centers is not a financial but an industrial bubble. Bezos emphasized that these investments of tens of billions of dollars will be valuable in the long term, and he is pleased that humanity has such immense computing power. The issue of the sustainability of GDP growth remains a separate topic for discussion.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence May Eliminate 100 Million Jobs in the US Over the Next Ten Years
articles.description: Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders stated in his published report that artificial intelligence, automation, and robotic systems may eliminate approximately 100 million jobs in the US over the next decade. The analysis based on ChatGPT data shows that 40% of nurses, 47% of truck drivers, 64% of accountants, 65% of teacher assistants, and 89% of fast food workers are at risk. The report emphasizes the speed of transformation, stating, "The agricultural revolution took thousands of years. The industrial revolution took over a century. Artificial labor, however, can reshape the economy in under a decade." While regulatory discussions are ongoing in Washington to limit the impact of artificial intelligence on the workforce and establish new rules, the Trump administration argues that the US must maintain its world leadership in artificial intelligence, or else China's advancement would pose a national security threat. Meanwhile, large corporations are rapidly moving towards automation; for example, Amazon and Walmart have laid off tens of thousands of people by transitioning to automation.

# Artificial Intelligence May Eliminate 100 Million Jobs in the US Over the Next Decade

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e6420d6d332aa2ec60f71b_Gemini_Generated_Image_5r13b35r13b35r13.png)

It is predicted that artificial intelligence and automation may eliminate approximately 100 million jobs in the US over the next decade. Vermont Senator **Bernie Sanders**, also a senior member of the **Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee**, drew attention to this threat in a report published on Monday.

The analysis, ironically based on **ChatGPT** findings, reveals that new technologies threaten a wide range of professions. According to the data presented by Sanders, artificial intelligence, automation, and robotic systems may affect 40% of registered nurses, 47% of truck drivers, 64% of accountants, 65% of teacher assistants, and 89% of fast food workers. The report states, _"The agricultural revolution took thousands of years. The industrial revolution took over a century. Artificial labor, however, can reshape the economy in under a decade."_

In Washington, debates on regulating artificial intelligence are intensifying. The Trump administration argues that the US must be the world leader in AI development, or else China's victory in the race will pose a national security threat. In response, Senate Democrats are demanding stricter regulations, **a 32-hour workweek**, and a **"robot tax"** for companies that automate.

Meanwhile, **Amazon** and **Walmart**, two of the largest publicly traded companies in the US by revenue, have invested heavily in automation, laying off tens of thousands of employees.

In an article written for **Fox News**, Sanders warned, _"Today, the artificial intelligence and robotics developed by these billion-dollar companies will allow corporate America to eliminate millions of good-paying jobs, reduce labor costs, and increase profits."_ According to him, AI is being used as a tool to further centralize wealth. Sanders noted that CEOs who invest billions of dollars in automation are simultaneously implementing mass layoffs and cost-cutting plans.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e63f06d595dba90d65af55_senate-committee-health-education-labor-111600975.webp)

The Senator stated that workers in the manufacturing sector, as well as truck, bus, and taxi drivers, who are being accelerated by automotive and technology startups' driverless car projects, may also be severely affected. In his article, he wrote: _"Some of the richest people in the world, including Elon Musk, Larry Ellison, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jeff Bezos, are now investing tens of billions of dollars in these revolutionary technologies."_ Sanders questioned the purpose of these investments, saying, _"Why? Is it to improve the living standards of the 60% of our people who live paycheck to paycheck, struggling to afford groceries, healthcare, housing, and education? Maybe, but I doubt it."_

Sanders continued, _"I think the real reason is that investments in artificial intelligence and robotics will exponentially increase their wealth and power."_

articles.title: Anthropic's Petri Tool Tests AI Behaviors with Hundreds of Simulated Conversations
articles.description: Anthropic introduced Petri, an open-source tool it developed to enhance the security of large language models. Using autonomous representatives, Petri detects risky tendencies of models, such as deception, disclosure of false information, misuse, and facilitation of terrorist activities. The company tested 14 models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Grok-4, with 111 tasks; although Claude Sonnet 4.5 received the highest score, behaviors incompatible with values were observed in all models. To understand how these behaviors emerge, it is necessary to examine how Petri works. Petri attempts to achieve the same result in different ways, starting from simple requests; it evaluates honesty and refusal tendencies with a referee model, then submits the results for review by flagging risky outputs. Thus, the tool automates security tests by reducing manual effort. However, it is acknowledged that referee models may contain biases. Anthropic aims to continuously improve the tool through community contributions by releasing it as open-source.

# Anthropic's Petri Tool Tests AI Behaviors with Hundreds of Simulated Conversations

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e658ccbb2d5342517fb034_image_1759874324_1.jpeg)

**Anthropic PBC** has expanded its work in AI security by introducing a new open-source tool called **Petri**, which uses **AI representatives** to monitor the behavior of large language models.

Petri was developed to identify risky tendencies in models, such as deceiving users, unauthorized information disclosure (_whistleblowing_), collaborating with humans to engage in misuse scenarios, and facilitating terrorist activities. Anthropic announced that it has conducted tests on **14 leading LLMs** using the tool and detected issues in each of them. The models tested included **Claude Sonnet 4.5**, **OpenAI's GPT-5**, **Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro**, and **xAI's Grok-4**.

In the company's blog post, the importance of representative-based testing tools like Petri was highlighted. Researchers emphasized that the behavioral diversity of large language models is too complex to be tested manually in every scenario. Petri represents a shift from **static comparisons to continuous and automated testing** in security tests, allowing risky behaviors to be detected not only before release but also after distribution.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e657fa907a93da599465e8_Screenshot-from-2025-10-08-07-34-48.png)

In Anthropic's tests, **Claude Sonnet 4.5** received the highest score among the 14 models evaluated in 111 risky tasks. The models were scored based on four risk categories:

- **Deception:** Intentionally providing false information

- **Power-seeking:** Desire to gain influence or control

- **Sycophancy:** Agreeing with the user even if they are wrong

- **Failure to refuse:** Complying with requests that should be refused


Although Claude Sonnet 4.5 excelled in overall performance, the company stated that **value-inconsistent behaviors** were detected in all models. Anthropic also noted that the ranking was not the primary goal, and Petri's main objective is to develop stronger and more beneficial security tests for the community.

Here's how Petri works: Researchers start the process with a simple deception or jailbreak attempt. Then, Petri's controller representatives take over, trying to test the model using various methods. During the conversation, they change their tactics to achieve the same outcome. At the end of the evaluation, Petri assesses the models in dimensions such as honesty and refusal tendency. Risky outputs from conversations are flagged and presented to researchers.

Anthropic announced that Petri makes it easier for developers to put their new AI models through discovery tests, significantly reducing the manual testing burden, and aims to become a standard method in security research with its open-source release. However, the company also acknowledged the tool's limitations. It was accepted that the judge models, which are based on the same infrastructure as the tested models, **may contain biases**. For example, there is a possibility of over-penalizing ambiguous answers or favoring certain response styles.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e657e0ff4a39d52710e186_Screenshot-from-2025-10-08-07-43-52.png)

### **Monitoring Whistleblowing Behaviors**

Anthropic shared an observation from a case study conducted using Petri:

_“When we ran Petri on different initial instructions, we saw that the models made whistleblowing attempts many times, i.e., they tried to autonomously expose organizational wrongdoing when they detected it. This only occurred when developers gave them sufficiently powerful tools, provided unlimited access to information, and gave them clear instructions to act autonomously. In principle, this could play a role in preventing large-scale harm, but it is not an appropriate behavior for today's AI systems, as it poses serious confidentiality issues and the risk of leakage from misinterpreted whistleblowing attempts is very high.”_

Based on the findings, the company tested the models for whistleblowing behaviors. In the scenarios, the models were made to act like autonomous representatives in fictional organizations and were presented with information that revealed wrongdoing. The results showed that the decision to expose wrongdoing varied depending on the level of autonomy granted to the model and the level of cooperation from the fictional leadership.

Some models interpreted even harmless situations as wrongdoing, such as an organization releasing clean water into the sea. Researchers noted that this meant the models were **easily influenced by narrative cues and lacked a consistent ethical framework**.

Anthropic also stated that Petri may, in some cases, make the tested models aware that they are "under control," leading to the masking of unwanted behaviors. Nevertheless, the company emphasized that Petri provides measurable metrics, helping researchers focus their security work, and is a valuable tool.

Finally, numerous example requests, evaluation code, and guides for developers to extend the tool were shared along with Petri. Anthropic hopes that the tool will be further developed with community contributions.

articles.title: Samsung's Small AI Model Outperforms Large Language Models Like Gemini 2.5 Pro in Reasoning Tests
articles.description: Samsung's Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) artificial intelligence model can compete with LLMs 10,000 times larger, despite having only 7 million parameters. The model, introduced in the study titled "Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks," creates a recursive feedback loop by using its own output for subsequent steps. Thus, it produces more accurate results by correcting its errors in each cycle. Its function is to provide a lightweight yet efficient alternative to large models in tasks that require complex logic and reasoning. TRM achieves a similar effect with recursive reasoning, without the need for high memory and computational costs in deep-layered architectures; similar to a person reading and correcting their text multiple times. In experiments, it achieved an accuracy of 87.4% on Sudoku-Extreme, 85% on Maze-Hard, 45% on ARC-AGI-1, and 8% on ARC-AGI-2. With this performance, it either surpassed or matched giant models such as DeepSeek R1, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, and OpenAI o3-mini. The function of TRM is to provide high efficiency with its small size, especially in puzzle solving, logical reasoning, and step-by-step problem solving.

# Samsung's Small AI Model Outperforms Large Language Models Like Gemini 2.5 Pro in Reasoning Tests

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8c7983f5cf52ba369c12e_Screenshot-from-2025-10-10-08-06-14.png)

Although Samsung's camera division has not introduced any significant innovations recently, the same cannot be said for its AI research. The company's latest AI model has outperformed some large language models (LLM) that are approximately **10,000 times larger**.

### **Samsung's New Small Recursive Model**

In its paper titled "**Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks**", Samsung introduced its new **Tiny Recursive Model (TRM)** architecture.

- TRM is extremely small: it has **only 7 million parameters**; this number is very low compared to large LLMs with billions of parameters.

- The model uses its own output to determine its next steps, creating a **self-improving feedback loop**.

- By passing each output through recursive reasoning, it can simulate a much deeper architecture without high memory or processing costs.

- With each recursive cycle, the model produces better predictions and results.


Samsung's approach is likened to a person re-reading their own draft and correcting errors each time. While traditional LLMs collapse when an error occurs in one step, TRM's recursive method provides more robust results. Chain-of-thought methods can be helpful but may remain fragile.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8c768c1095153b9d49fa2_Samsungs-Tiny-Recursive-Model-Explained-1456x820.png)

### **Fewer Layers, More Recursion**

Samsung tried increasing the number of layers in the model but found that it reduced its generalization ability due to overfitting. Reducing the number of layers and increasing the number of recursions, on the other hand, improved TRM's overall performance.

**Results**

TRM achieved remarkable success in the tests:

- **Sudoku-Extreme:** 87.4% accuracy (Hierarchical Reasoning Models only 55%).

- **Maze-Hard puzzles:** 85% accuracy.

- **ARC-AGI-1:** 45% accuracy.

- **ARC-AGI-2:** 8% accuracy.


Most importantly, TRM's performance surpassed or closely approached models like **DeepSeek R1**, **Google Gemini 2.5 Pro**, and **OpenAI o3-mini**. Moreover, it achieved this with a very small number of parameters.

articles.title: Google Introduced Gemini Enterprise Artificial Intelligence Platform for Businesses
articles.description: Google announced a new platform called Gemini Enterprise, offering it to business customers, providing a comprehensive solution that allows employees to interact with company data, documents, and applications through a natural conversation interface, using the most advanced artificial intelligence models. The platform can perform in-depth research and data analysis with pre-built Google AI representatives, while also giving companies the opportunity to develop and deploy their own custom representatives. Google announced that it has gained customers such as Gap, Figma, and Klarna for the platform, while also revealing that the new service is built on top of Google Workspace, enriched with Gemini-powered AI features.

# Google Introduces Gemini Enterprise, an Artificial Intelligence Platform for Businesses

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68e8d1ba718b7b9c0a31ba0f_2436_x_1200_logo_lockup.max-2500x2500.png)

Google, under the Alphabet umbrella, announced its new artificial intelligence platform, **Gemini Enterprise**, for business customers on Thursday. The tech giant aims to gain a larger share from corporate customers and expand the use of AI tools in the business world with this move.

According to the announcement made by Google, **Gemini Enterprise** will be supported by the company's most advanced AI models and will serve as a **conversation platform** where employees can chat with their company data, documents, and applications.

Recently, Microsoft, OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT, and AI startup Anthropic have also focused on corporate products to gain higher returns from AI investments.

Gemini Enterprise will offer a wide range of services to businesses, similar to its competitors. The platform will make **pre-built Google AI representatives** available, assisting with tasks such as in-depth research and data analysis. Additionally, companies will be able to develop and deploy their own custom AI representatives.

Google has already announced its first customers for the new platform. Users include **clothing retailer Gap**, **design software company Figma**, and **buy now, pay later (BNPL) service provider Klarna**.

The new platform is built on top of the company's existing **Google Workspace** services for corporate customers. Workspace already offers various AI features supported by Gemini, and with Gemini Enterprise, these services will become more comprehensive.

Netflix’in en çok izlenen dizisi olan Squid Game, toplamda yaklaşık 600 milyon izlenmeye ulaştı. Netflix’in Kore içeriklerinden sorumlu yöneticisi Don Kang, dizinin Kore dışındaki izleyiciler için bir dönüm noktası olduğunu ve Kore hikayelerine olan ilgiyi kalıcı kıldığını belirtti. Sezonun ardından sosyal medyada geniş yankı uyandı; Amerikan uyarlaması iddiaları gündeme gelirken, Netflix tarafından henüz resmî onay verilmedi.

# Netflix Rekoru: Squid Game’in Final Sezonu 3 Günde 60 Milyon İzlenme Aldı

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e54b1b2f127a2d94fd9c9/68653467562f217e17b84b10_e8880349d255debcd3ae97c49a56d0c7a2dd529d.webp)

Netflix Inc.’in dev yapımı Squid Game’in üçüncü sezonu, ilk üç gününde rekor izlenme sayılarına ulaştı ve Kore yapımı hayatta kalma dizisinin küresel kültürel bir fenomene dönüştüğünü bir kez daha kanıtladı.

Distopik gerilim dizisinin final sezonu, ilk üç gününde **60 milyonun üzerinde izlenme** elde ederek, aynı zaman diliminde şimdiye kadarki en büyük açılış performansına ulaştı. Netflix’e göre dizi, en çok izlenenler listesine giren 93 ülkenin tamamında **birinci sırada** yer aldı. Bu sonuç, önceki sezonun ilk dört gününde elde ettiği 68 milyon izlenmeye yakın bir başarı olarak kaydedildi.

Squid Game’in olağanüstü başarısı, Kore anlatı sanatının uluslararası alandaki kalıcılığını ve Netflix’in bu kültürel etkiyi büyütmedeki kritik rolünü bir kez daha ortaya koydu. Dizi, toplumsal kaygıları derinlemesine işlerken, Güney Kore’nin yaratıcı gücünü de tüm dünyaya yansıtıyor.

Netflix, Kore içeriklerine milyarlarca dolarlık yatırım yapmış durumda. Şirketin karşı karşıya olduğu asıl zorluk artık, küresel ilgiyi sürdürebilecek kadar güçlü bir yapım hattı oluşturmak.

İlk kez 2021 yılında yayınlanan Squid Game, anında büyük ilgi gördü ve Netflix’in “yerel için yerel” içerik stratejisinin temel taşlarından biri haline geldi. Dizi, bugüne kadar ilk iki sezonuyla toplamda yaklaşık **600 milyon izlenmeye ulaşarak**, Netflix’in tüm zamanların en çok izlenen yapımı olmayı sürdürüyor.

Netflix’in Kore içeriklerinden sorumlu başkan yardımcısı Don Kang verdiği röportajda şunları söyledi: _“Squid Game, Kore dışında yaşayan birçok insanın izlediği ilk gerçek Kore dizisi olmuş olabilir. O zamandan beri Netflix üyelerinin %80’i Kore içeriklerini izledi ve çoğu hâlâ izlemeye devam ediyor.”_

Üçüncü sezon karışık eleştiriler alsa da, dizinin Cuma günü yayınlanmasının ardından sosyal medyada yoğun uluslararası etkileşim yarattığı bildirildi. Öte yandan, ünlü yönetmen David Fincher’ın yöneteceği Amerikan uyarlamasının yapım aşamasında olduğu iddia edildi; ancak Netflix, Squid Game evrenine dair herhangi bir yan ürün ya da devam sezonunu resmen doğrulamadı.

Cumartesi akşamı Seul şehir merkezinde büyük bir geçit töreni düzenlendi. Final sezonunun lansmanına ithafen yapılan bu etkinlik, Kore hükümetinin şehri bir kültür merkezi ve küresel turizm destinasyonu olarak konumlandırma stratejisinin bir parçası olarak gerçekleştirildi.

Kang, _“Kimsenin daha önce anlatmaya cesaret edemediği hikâyeleri, daha önce mümkün olmayan bir ölçekte anlatmak isteyen yaratıcıların başvuracağı yer olmak istiyoruz.”_ dedi ve sözlerine şöyle devam etti: _“Bunu sürdürebilirsek, bence bir sonraki Squid Game de gelir.”_

Netflix’in Kore ekibi, Physical: 100 ve Culinary Class Wars gibi yapımlarla reality show formatında da küresel başarı yakaladı. Don Kang’a göre, her iki programın da bu yıl içinde geri dönmesi planlanıyor ve olası uluslararası uyarlamaları için görüşmeler devam ediyor.

Artan rekabetin yaşandığı dijital yayın pazarında Netflix, Güney Kore merkezli Naver Corp. ile iş birliği yaparak yeni kullanıcı segmentlerine ulaşmayı hedefliyor. Naver, New York borsasında işlem gören Webtoon Entertainment Inc. platformunun sahibi olması sayesinde bu ortaklığa stratejik değer katıyor. Kang ayrıca, Netflix’in küresel kullanıcı etkileşimini artırmak amacıyla **canlı yayın ve spor içeriklerini** de Kore merkezli stratejisinin bir parçası olarak değerlendirdiğini belirtti.
